code: deaths <- data.frame(age = rownames(VADeaths), VADeaths, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) names(deaths) <- c("age", "rural_male", "rural_female", "urban_male", "urban_female") deaths$lowest  <- apply(VADeaths, 1, min) deaths$highest <- apply(VADeaths, 1, max) deaths #>         age rural_male rural_female urban_male urban_female lowest highest #> 50-54 50-54       11.7          8.7       15.4          8.4    8.4    15.4 #> 55-59 55-59       18.1         11.7       24.3         13.6   11.7    24.3 #> 60-64 60-64       26.9         20.3       37.0         19.3   19.3    37.0 #> 65-69 65-69       41.0         30.9       54.6         35.1   30.9    54.6 #> 70-74 70-74       66.0         54.3       71.1         50.0   50.0    71.1  groups <- c("rural_male", "rural_female", "urban_male", "urban_female") deaths_long <- data.frame(   age   = rep(deaths$age, times = length(groups)),   group = factor(rep(groups, each = nrow(deaths))),   rate  = unlist(deaths[, groups], use.names = FALSE),   stringsAsFactors = FALSE) head(deaths_long) #>     age        group rate #> 1 50-54   rural_male 11.7 #> 2 55-59   rural_male 18.1 #> 3 60-64   rural_male 26.9 #> 4 65-69   rural_male 41.0 #> 5 70-74   rural_male 66.0 #> 6 50-54 rural_female  8.7

code: # Shiny gallery: Progress bar example (shiny-examples 085-progress) # https://shiny.posit.co/r/gallery/advanced-shiny/progress-bar-example/ name: Progress bar example layout: page  # a function used by the table service, defined at the start of each session prescript: |   compute_data <- function(updateProgress = NULL) {     dat <- data.frame(x = numeric(0), y = numeric(0))     for (i in 1:10) {       Sys.sleep(0.25)       new_row <- data.frame(x = rnorm(1), y = rnorm(1))       if (is.function(updateProgress)) {         text <- paste0("x:", round(new_row$x, 2), " y:", round(new_row$y, 2))         updateProgress(detail = text)       }       dat <- rbind(dat, new_row)     }     dat   }  items:   page:     type: fluidPage     layout: [plot, table, style, goPlot, goTable]    plot:     type: plotOutput     width: 300px     height: 300px     service: |       input$goPlot # Re-run when button is clicked       style <- isolate(input$style)       withProgress(message = 'Creating plot', style = style, value = 0.1, {         Sys.sleep(0.25)         dat <- data.frame(x = numeric(0), y = numeric(0))         withProgress(message = 'Generating data', style = style, detail = "part 0", value = 0, {           for (i in 1:10) {             dat <- rbind(dat, data.frame(x = rnorm(1), y = rnorm(1)))             incProgress(0.1, detail = paste("part", i))             Sys.sleep(0.1)           }         })         incProgress(0.5)         withProgress(message = 'And this also', detail = "This other thing", style = style, value = NULL, {           Sys.sleep(0.75)         })         setProgress(1)       })       plot(cars$speed, cars$dist)    table:     type: tableOutput     service: |       input$goTable       style <- isolate(input$style)       progress <- shiny::Progress$new(style = style)       progress$set(message = "Computing data", value = 0)       on.exit(progress$close())       updateProgress <- function(value = NULL, detail = NULL) {         if (is.null(value)) {           value <- progress$getValue()           value <- value + (progress$getMax() - value) / 5         }         progress$set(value = value, detail = detail)       }       compute_data(updateProgress)    style:     type: radioButtons     title: Progress bar style     choices: [notification, old]    goPlot:  {type: actionButton, title: Go plot}   goTable: {type: actionButton, title: Go table}

title: Dashboards: gallery
text: Run : runDashboard(rvisDashboardExample("us-states")) multi-page shinydashboard 50 US states (R data sets state.x77, state.region state.center): sidebar menu six pages two filters applying pages, value boxes, rvis charts made rvisPlot() (highcharter bar pie charts, plotly scatter chart), leaflet map, table download button, help window (bsModal), tooltips, popover guided tour. Needs packages shinydashboard, shinyBS, highcharter, plotly, leaflet, DT rintrojs.
code:
# A multi-page shinydashboard about the 50 US states (data sets state.x77, state.region, state.center). # It shows: sidebar menu and pages, filters in the sidebar, value boxes, rvis charts (highcharter, plotly), # a leaflet map, tables with download, a modal help window, tooltips, popovers and a guided tour. # Needs packages shinydashboard, shinyBS, highcharter, plotly, leaflet, DT and rintrojs. name: US states explorer layout: dash # data prepared at the start of each session prescript: | states <- data.frame( state = state.name, abb = state.abb, region = as.character(state.region), lat = state.center$y, long = state.center$x, state.x77, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) names(states) <- c("state", "abb", "region", "lat", "long", "Population", "Income", "Illiteracy", "Life.Exp", "Murder", "HS.Grad", "Frost", "Area") measures <- c("Population (thousands)" = "Population", "Income per capita ($)" = "Income", "Illiteracy (%)" = "Illiteracy", "Life expectancy (years)" = "Life.Exp", "Murder rate (per 100,000)" = "Murder", "High-school graduates (%)" = "HS.Grad", "Days with frost" = "Frost", "Area (square miles)" = "Area") label <- function(m) names(measures)[measures == m] selected <- reactive({ validate(need(length(input$regions) > 0, "Select at least one region.")) states[states$region %in% input$regions, ] }) items: dash: type: dashboardPage title: US states explorer skin: blue header.title: US states header.title.font: trebuchet ms header.title.font.weight: bold layout.side: [menu, regions, measure, help, tour] layout.body: [pages, help_modal] # ---- sidebar ---- menu: type: sidebarMenu layout: [m_overview, m_rankings, m_relations, m_map, m_data, m_about] m_overview: {type: menuItem, title: Overview, tabName: overview, icon: gauge} m_rankings: {type: menuItem, title: Rankings, tabName: rankings, icon: ranking-star} m_relations: {type: menuItem, title: Relationships, tabName: relations, icon: chart-line} m_map: {type: menuItem, title: Map, tabName: map, icon: map-location-dot} m_data: {type: menuItem, title: Data, tabName: data, icon: table} m_about: {type: menuItem, title: About, tabName: about, icon: circle-info} regions: type: checkboxGroupInput title: Regions choices: !expr levels(state.region) selected: !expr levels(state.region) tooltip: The states of the selected regions are shown on all pages. tooltip.placement: right tutor.lesson: Choose the regions of the states shown on all pages. tutor.step: 2 measure: type: selectInput title: Measure choices: {Population (thousands): Population, Income per capita ($): Income, Illiteracy (%): Illiteracy, Life expectancy (years): Life.Exp, Murder rate (per 100000): Murder, High-school graduates (%): HS.Grad, Days with frost: Frost, Area (square miles): Area} selected: Income tutor.lesson: The measure shown by the charts, the map and the rankings. tutor.step: 3 help: type: actionButton title: Help icon: circle-question width: 85% tour: type: actionButton title: Guided tour icon: route width: 85% service: rintrojs::introjs(session) help_modal: type: bsModal title: How to use this dashboard trigger: help layout: [help_text] help_text: type: static html: |

Use the menu on the left to change pages. The Regions and Measure filters apply to all pages.

  • Overview: key figures and the measure by region.
  • Rankings: states with the highest and lowest values.
  • Relationships: compare two measures.
  • Map: the measure at the centre of each state.
  • Data: the table, which can be downloaded.
# ---- pages ---- pages: type: tabItems layout: [overview, rankings, relations, map, data, about] overview: type: tabItem layout: - [n_states, population, income, life] - [by_region, share] rankings: type: tabItem layout: - [top_n] - [top, bottom] relations: type: tabItem layout: - [x_measure, y_measure] - [scatter, correlations] map: type: tabItem layout: [leaflet_map] data: type: tabItem layout: [table_box] about: type: tabItem layout: [about_text] # ---- overview ---- n_states: type: valueBoxOutput weight: 3 service: valueBox(nrow(selected()), "States", icon = icon("flag-usa"), color = "blue") tutor.lesson: Key figures of the selected states. tutor.step: 1 population: type: valueBoxOutput weight: 3 service: valueBox(format(round(sum(selected()$Population) / 1000, 1), nsmall = 1), "Population (millions, 1975)", icon = icon("users"), color = "aqua") income: type: valueBoxOutput weight: 3 service: valueBox(paste0("$", format(round(mean(selected()$Income)), big.mark = ",")), "Mean income per capita (1974)", icon = icon("dollar-sign"), color = "green") life: type: valueBoxOutput weight: 3 service: valueBox(round(mean(selected()$Life.Exp), 1), "Mean life expectancy (1969-71)", icon = icon("heart-pulse"), color = "red") by_region: type: highcharterOutput height: 320px service: | d <- aggregate(selected()[input$measure], list(region = selected()$region), mean) rvisPlot(type = "bar", plotter = "highcharter", obj = d, x = "region", y = input$measure) cloth: {type: box, title: Mean by region, status: primary, solidHeader: true, weight: 7} popover: Mean of the selected measure over the states of each region. popover.title: By region share: type: highcharterOutput height: 320px service: | d <- aggregate(Population ~ region, data = selected(), FUN = sum) rvisPlot(type = "pie", plotter = "highcharter", obj = d, label = "region", theta = "Population") cloth: {type: box, title: Population by region, status: primary, solidHeader: true, weight: 5} # ---- rankings ---- top_n: type: sliderInput title: Number of states min: 3 max: 15 value: 8 cloth: {type: box, weight: 4} top: type: highcharterOutput height: 360px service: | d <- head(selected()[order(-selected()[[input$measure]]), c("state", input$measure)], input$top_n) rvisPlot(type = "bar", plotter = "highcharter", obj = d, x = "state", y = input$measure) cloth: {type: box, title: Highest, status: success, weight: 6} bottom: type: highcharterOutput height: 360px service: | d <- head(selected()[order(selected()[[input$measure]]), c("state", input$measure)], input$top_n) rvisPlot(type = "bar", plotter = "highcharter", obj = d, x = "state", y = input$measure) cloth: {type: box, title: Lowest, status: danger, weight: 6} # ---- relationships ---- x_measure: type: selectInput title: Horizontal axis choices: [Population, Income, Illiteracy, Life.Exp, Murder, HS.Grad, Frost, Area] selected: Illiteracy cloth: {type: box, weight: 6} y_measure: type: selectInput title: Vertical axis choices: [Population, Income, Illiteracy, Life.Exp, Murder, HS.Grad, Frost, Area] selected: Murder cloth: {type: box, weight: 6} scatter: type: plotlyOutput height: 400px service: rvisPlot(type = "scatter", plotter = "plotly", obj = selected(), x = input$x_measure, y = input$y_measure, color = "region", label = "state") cloth: {type: box, title: States, weight: 8} correlations: type: tableOutput digits: 2 rownames: true service: cor(selected()[, c("Population", "Income", "Illiteracy", "Life.Exp", "Murder", "HS.Grad", "Frost")])[, c(input$x_measure, input$y_measure), drop = FALSE] cloth: {type: box, title: Correlations, weight: 4} # ---- map ---- leaflet_map: type: leafletOutput height: 560px service: | d <- selected() v <- d[[input$measure]] pal <- leaflet::colorNumeric("viridis", v) leaflet::leaflet(d) %>% leaflet::addTiles() %>% leaflet::addCircleMarkers(lng = ~long, lat = ~lat, radius = 6 + 14 * (v - min(v)) / diff(range(v)), color = pal(v), fillOpacity = 0.8, stroke = FALSE, label = paste0(d$state, ": ", format(v, big.mark = ","))) %>% leaflet::addLegend(pal = pal, values = v, title = label(input$measure)) cloth: {type: box, title: Measure at the centre of each state, weight: 12} # ---- data ---- # a bag (a simple container) with a box cloth table_box: type: bag layout: [download, states_table] cloth: {type: box, title: The selected states, weight: 12} download: type: downloadButton title: Download CSV filename: '"us-states.csv"' service: write.csv(selected(), file, row.names = FALSE) states_table: type: dataTableOutput options: {pageLength: 10, scrollX: true} service: selected() # ---- about ---- about_text: type: static html: |

About the data

Statistics of the 50 US states from the 1977 Statistical Abstract of the United States (R data sets state.x77, state.region and state.center).

This dashboard is made of a single YAML file: rvisDashboardExample("us-states").

text: type item (cloth) can function package, written package::function, like shinyWidgets::pickerInput, shinydashboard::box apexcharter::apexchartOutput. function called fields item arguments, : use argument names package documentation (example label, title, label shiny::selectInput). every function every package, including functions added future versions, can dashboard item without changes rvis. role item found arguments function: inputs: functions argument inputId get item name inputId. service runs input changes, updateItem4Session() / updateItem() call package’s update function (fooInput updated updateFooInput). outputs: functions argument outputId get item name outputId. service rendered package’s render function matching output function (fooOutput renderFoo). containers: functions get items layout unnamed arguments (item name id, argument id item none). fields used rvis passed function: short type names sections (like selectInput box) keep settings, like title label input.
code: # Any function of any package can be an item type: write the type as package::function. # The item fields are passed to the function as they are (same argument names as in the package documentation). #  - inputs  (functions with argument inputId) get the item name as inputId; their service runs when the input changes #  - outputs (functions with argument outputId) get the item name as outputId; their service is rendered by the #    matching render function of the package (fooOutput -> renderFoo) or by the function given in field 'render' #  - containers (all other functions) get the items of their layout as unnamed arguments; field 'args' gives #    unnamed arguments passed first, like the text of a heading name: Generic item types layout: page  items:   page:     type: shiny::fluidPage     title: Generic item types     layout: [heading, row]    heading:     type: shiny::h3     args: [Items built by calling package functions directly]    row:     type: shiny::fluidRow     layout: [side, main]    side:     type: shiny::column     width: 4     layout: [dist, n, go]    main:     type: shiny::column     width: 8     layout: [hist, summary]    dist:     type: shiny::selectInput     label: Distribution     choices: {Normal: norm, Uniform: unif, Exponential: exp}    n:     type: shiny::sliderInput     label: Number of observations     min: 10     max: 1000     value: 200    go:     type: shiny::actionButton     label: Reset     icon: !expr shiny::icon('rotate-left')     service: updateItem4Session('n', session, value = 200)    hist:     type: shiny::plotOutput     height: 300px     # a generic cloth: the output is passed (last) to the cloth function, with the other cloth fields as arguments     cloth: {type: shiny::wellPanel}     service: |       x <- switch(input$dist, norm = rnorm(input$n), unif = runif(input$n), exp = rexp(input$n))       hist(x, col = '#75AADB', border = 'white', main = paste(input$n, input$dist, 'values'))    summary:     type: shiny::verbatimTextOutput     service: summary(switch(input$dist, norm = rnorm(input$n), unif = runif(input$n), exp = rexp(input$n)))

# Server-side state: reactive values (sync), session objects, a prescript, input services and observers. name: Reactive values layout: page # objects: copied into session$userData of each session (not reactive) objects: step: 1 greeting: Hello from session$userData # values: initial values of the reactive list 'sync' of each session; outputs using sync$... update when they change values: count: 0 log: [] # prescript: run at the start of each session, for example to define reactive expressions and functions prescript: | squared <- reactive(sync$count^2) add_log <- function(text) isolate(sync$log <- head(c(paste(format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"), text), unlist(sync$log)), 10)) # observers: R code run in observe(): run again whenever a reactive value used in them changes observers: - if (sync$count >= 10) showNotification("The count reached 10 or more!", type = "warning") items: page: type: fluidPage title: Reactive values, services and observers layout: - - {weight: 4, items: controls} - {weight: 8, items: [count_text, squared_text, greeting, log_title, log]} controls: type: wellPanel layout: [step, plus, minus, reset] step: type: numericInput title: Step value: 1 min: 1 # service of an input: run when the input changes service: session$userData$step <- input$step # services of action buttons run when they are clicked plus: type: actionButton title: Add icon: plus service: | sync$count <- sync$count + session$userData$step add_log(paste("added", session$userData$step)) # isolate: true runs the service in isolate(), so reading reactive values does not create dependencies isolate: true minus: type: actionButton title: Subtract icon: minus isolate: true service: | sync$count <- sync$count - session$userData$step add_log(paste("subtracted", session$userData$step)) reset: type: actionLink title: Reset service: | sync$count <- 0 add_log("reset") count_text: type: textOutput tag: h2 service: paste("Count:", sync$count) squared_text: type: textOutput service: paste("Count squared (a reactive expression from the prescript):", squared()) greeting: type: textOutput service: session$userData$greeting log_title: {type: static, html: "

Log

Methods hideItems(), showItems(), disableItems() enableItems() hide, show, disable enable items (tab panels ). use package shinyjs, whose javascript added page service, observer prescript uses (settings: {shinyjs: true}). updateItem4Session(item, session, ...) updates input shiny update function type (updateSelectInput(), updateSliderInput(), …; also selected tab navbar page, navigation list sidebar menu). updateItem(item, ...) updates open sessions (settings: {keepSessions: true}).
code: # A dynamic user interface: inputs built by the server, conditional panels, hiding/showing and # enabling/disabling items (package shinyjs) and updating inputs from the server. name: Dynamic interface layout: page  items:   page:     type: fluidPage     title: Dynamic user interface     layout:       - - {weight: 4, items: controls}         - {weight: 8, items: [plot, actions]}    controls:     type: wellPanel     layout: [dataset, variable, show_options, options]    dataset:     type: selectInput     title: Dataset     choices: [mtcars, airquality, faithful, trees]    # a dynamic input: its service returns an input built from the current dataset   variable:     type: dynamicInput     service: selectInput("var", "Variable", choices = names(Filter(is.numeric, get(input$dataset))))    show_options:     type: checkboxInput     title: Show plot options    # shown only when the javascript condition is true   options:     type: conditionalPanel     condition: input.show_options == true     layout: [bins, color]    bins:  {type: sliderInput, title: Bins, min: 5, max: 50, value: 20}   color: {type: radioButtons, title: Colour, choices: [steelblue, darkorange, seagreen], inline: true}    plot:     type: plotOutput     service: |       req(input$var, input$var %in% names(get(input$dataset)))       x <- get(input$dataset)[[input$var]]       hist(x, breaks = if (is.null(input$bins)) 20 else input$bins, col = if (is.null(input$color)) "steelblue" else input$color,            border = "white", main = paste(input$dataset, input$var, sep = ": "), xlab = input$var)    actions:     type: fluidPage     layout: [[hide, show, disable, enable, first]]    # methods hideItems(), showItems(), disableItems() and enableItems() of the dashboard (the shinyjs   # javascript is added to the page because the services use them)   hide:    {type: actionButton, title: Hide plot, service: hideItems("plot")}   show:    {type: actionButton, title: Show plot, service: showItems("plot")}   disable: {type: actionButton, title: Disable dataset, service: disableItems("dataset")}   enable:  {type: actionButton, title: Enable dataset, service: enableItems("dataset")}   # updateItem4Session() updates an input of the session with the shiny update function of its type   first:     type: actionButton     title: First dataset     service: updateItem4Session("dataset", session, selected = "mtcars")

code: titanic <- as.data.frame(Titanic, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) head(titanic) #>   Class    Sex   Age Survived Freq #> 1   1st   Male Child       No    0 #> 2   2nd   Male Child       No    0 #> 3   3rd   Male Child       No   35 #> 4  Crew   Male Child       No    0 #> 5   1st Female Child       No    0 #> 6   2nd Female Child       No    0  # People per class, for single level charts classes <- aggregate(Freq ~ Class, data = titanic, FUN = sum) classes$survived <- aggregate(Freq ~ Class, data = titanic[titanic$Survived == "Yes", ], FUN = sum)$Freq classes$survival_rate <- round(classes$survived / classes$Freq, 2) classes #>   Class Freq survived survival_rate #> 1   1st  325      203          0.62 #> 2   2nd  285      118          0.41 #> 3   3rd  706      178          0.25 #> 4  Crew  885      212          0.24 flows <- df2Network(titanic, id_cols = c("Class", "Sex", "Survived"), value_col = "Freq") flows$nodes$label <- sub(".*=", "", flows$nodes$label)    # "Class=1st" is shown as "1st" flows$links <- as.data.frame(flows$links) head(flows$nodes) #>           id  label #> 1 Sex=Female Female #> 2   Sex=Male   Male #> 3  Class=1st    1st #> 4  Class=2nd    2nd #> 5  Class=3rd    3rd #> 6 Class=Crew   Crew head(flows$links[, c("source", "target", "value", "ratio")]) #>       source       target value ratio #> 1 Sex=Female  Survived=No   126 26.81 #> 2 Sex=Female Survived=Yes   344 73.19 #> 3   Sex=Male  Survived=No  1364 78.80 #> 4   Sex=Male Survived=Yes   367 21.20 #> 5  Class=1st   Sex=Female   145 44.62 #> 6  Class=1st     Sex=Male   180 55.38

title: Parts of a whole: pie, funnel, pyramid, gauge, bullet and word cloud charts

code: hec <- as.data.frame(HairEyeColor, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)  hair <- aggregate(Freq ~ Hair, data = hec, FUN = sum)          # students per hair colour eyes <- aggregate(Freq ~ Eye, data = hec, FUN = sum)           # students per eye colour eyes <- eyes[order(eyes$Freq, decreasing = TRUE), ] hair #>    Hair Freq #> 1 Black  108 #> 2 Blond  127 #> 3 Brown  286 #> 4   Red   71 eyes #>     Eye Freq #> 2 Brown  220 #> 1  Blue  215 #> 4 Hazel   93 #> 3 Green   64  # One row per student, for charts that count rows themselves students <- hec[rep(seq_len(nrow(hec)), hec$Freq), c("Hair", "Eye", "Sex")]  # Hair and eye colour combinations, for the word cloud combos <- aggregate(Freq ~ Hair + Eye, data = hec, FUN = sum) combos$label <- paste(combos$Hair, "hair", combos$Eye, "eyes")  # Share of students with brown eyes, in percent, for gauges and bullets brown <- data.frame(label = "Brown eyes", percent = round(100 * eyes$Freq[eyes$Eye == "Brown"] / sum(eyes$Freq), 1)) brown #>        label percent #> 1 Brown eyes    37.2

title: Time series: line, area, bar and calendar charts over time
text: airquality daily measurements New York May September 1973.
code: air <- airquality air$date <- as.Date(sprintf("1973-%02d-%02d", air$Month, air$Day)) air$time <- as.POSIXct(air$date, tz = "UTC")           # date-time version, for plotters that need it air <- air[, c("date", "time", "Temp", "Wind", "Ozone", "Solar.R")] head(air) #>         date       time Temp Wind Ozone Solar.R #> 1 1973-05-01 1973-05-01   67  7.4    41     190 #> 2 1973-05-02 1973-05-02   72  8.0    36     118 #> 3 1973-05-03 1973-05-03   74 12.6    12     149 #> 4 1973-05-04 1973-05-04   62 11.5    18     313 #> 5 1973-05-05 1973-05-05   56 14.3    NA      NA #> 6 1973-05-06 1973-05-06   66 14.9    28      NA  # Long (molten) table: one row per day and measure air_long <- data.frame(   date    = rep(air$date, times = 2),   measure = factor(rep(c("Temp", "Wind"), each = nrow(air))),   value   = c(air$Temp, air$Wind)) head(air_long) #>         date measure value #> 1 1973-05-01    Temp    67 #> 2 1973-05-02    Temp    72 #> 3 1973-05-03    Temp    74 #> 4 1973-05-04    Temp    62 #> 5 1973-05-05    Temp    56 #> 6 1973-05-06    Temp    66  # Weekly means, for bar charts air$week <- as.Date(cut(air$date, "week")) weekly <- aggregate(cbind(Temp, Wind) ~ week, data = air, FUN = mean) names(weekly)[1] <- "date" head(weekly) #>         date     Temp     Wind #> 1 1973-04-30 66.16667 11.45000 #> 2 1973-05-07 66.14286 10.98571 #> 3 1973-05-14 63.28571 12.45714 #> 4 1973-05-21 60.85714 12.50000 #> 5 1973-05-28 74.57143 10.62857 #> 6 1973-06-04 84.85714 10.57143

text: Creates DASHBOARD object configuration given YAML JSON file, R list. configuration fields (items layout required): name Name dashboard. items Named list dashboard items. item type (input, output container type)   settings type. Output items service: R code returning content output.   Input items can service: R code run input changes. layout Name(s) item(s) making page, usually single page container like   fluidPage, dashboardPage navbarPage. objects Named list objects copied session$userData session. values Named list initial values reactive list sync session. prescript R code run start session (example define reactive expressions). observers R code (one text per observer) run observe() session. settings, messages, loginTable Settings, messages users dashboards login item. type item (cloth) can also function package, written package::function, like shinyWidgets::pickerInput shinydashboard::box. item fields passed function , argument names package documentation. Functions argument inputId make inputs functions argument outputId make outputs (item name passed id); functions containers get items layout unnamed arguments. fields used rvis passed function: args (unnamed arguments passed first, like text shiny::h3), service, layout, cloth, role (input, output container, detected role wrong), render (render function output, default package's renderFoo output fooOutput), render.args (arguments render function), update (function used updateItem(), default package's updateFoo input foo) tooltip, popover tutor fields.
